主要内容: Credicorp Ltd. announced that its Board of Directors unanimously agreed to set the date for the Annual General Meeting of Shareholders for Wednesday, March 28th, 2018, at 3 p.m. (Peruvian time), at the main offices of Banco de Credito del Peru. The meeting will consider the Annual Report for the financial year ended December 31st, 2017, the audited consolidated financial statements of the Company and its subsidiaries for the same period, and the appointment of external independent auditors for the financial year 2018. Shareholders registered as of February 7th, 2018, will be entitled to attend and vote in the meeting. If the required quorum is not met, the meeting will be postponed to Wednesday, April 4th, 2018, at the same location and time.
